Martin Woelfl's 2024 championship pour-over guide specifies 17 g coffee at 490 microns, 270 ml water at 93°C, an OREA V4 with fast bottom, and four pours: 60 g at 0 seconds, 60 g at 40 seconds, 50 g at 80 seconds, and 100 g at 120 seconds. Reported total brew time is 2:20–2:25.
